title: THE MPEMBA PHENOMENON
narration_text: Under specific conditions, hot water can freeze faster than cold water—a thermodynamic mystery known as the Mpemba Effect. For centuries, scientists have debated why this happens. Key factors include rapid evaporation, which reduces the hot water's volume, and strong convection currents that accelerate heat loss. While still a subject of scientific inquiry, it challenges our basic assumptions about thermal dynamics and cooling rates.
